description: Message channel bound to an MCP server the plugin provides.

server.description: Name of an MCP server key in this plugin's mcpServers that the channel binds to.

displayName.description: Human-readable name in the config dialog title (defaults to the server name).
displayName.x-note: Present in the SchemaStore baseline and accepted by CLI 2.1.281; not in the docs.

userConfig.description: User-configurable values prompted when the plugin is enabled. Keys must be valid identifiers.
